name: LinPrim Differentiable Rendering Pipeline
aliases: Linear Primitives for Differentiable Volumetric Rendering
definition: A two-stage rendering process consisting of per-primitive preprocessing followed by per-pixel rasterization, enabling efficient parallelization and real-time performance.
summary: LinPrim is a differentiable rendering pipeline using convex polyhedral primitives and differentiable ray-triangle intersections to explicitly optimize sharp geometry while maintaining real-time performance.
